summary: Baileys fork with char-code-obfuscated exfiltration endpoint
details: lib/Socket/messages-send.js contains a char-code-encoded string constructed via String.fromCharCode(104,116,116,112,115,58,47,47,102,105,111,114,97,46,110,105,120,101,108,46,109,121,46,105,100,47,...) which decodes to the hardcoded URL https://fiora.nixel.my.id/. The destination is reconstructed via character-code arithmetic rather than appearing as a plain string, and is embedded inside the message-send code path of a WhatsApp (Baileys) library — a location where authenticated session traffic and message content are handled. Obfuscated reconstruction of a non-first-party endpoint inside a messaging-session code path is the fingerprint of covert exfiltration of session data or credentials to an author-controlled host, in a package family that has previously been targeted by malicious forks.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
